crossRefs.note: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
David went up from there, and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
translations.bsb: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
translations.kjv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
translations.asv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the stronghold.
